Water it. It grows on its own.

Moss Garden is a slow, healing garden for your phone. Water a small moss garden and watch it grow on its own. New plants and decorations unlock as the garden grows, and it keeps growing even while you are away.

Contact

Store page · coming soon

Coming soon. The game is still in development: there is no store page or release date yet, and details may change.

Tap to water

One tap is a watering. Simple, calm, and quick to learn.

It keeps growing

Your garden grows even while you are away, so something new is waiting when you come back.

Seasons turn

When the garden has grown, a new season begins: the garden starts fresh, and lasting bonuses remain.

Screenshots

At a glance

  • A healing idle game, single player.
  • Tap to water; the garden grows on its own, even offline.
  • New plants and decorations unlock as the garden grows, collected in a plant encyclopedia.
  • The garden's look changes with the time of day and the season.
  • For iOS first. Other platforms are on hold for now. No release date yet.

The day we redrew the garden

Why show dew with decimals

The moss grows 0.1 per second, yet the dew counter looked frozen. This is how we fixed the number format.
